name: Beam source
description: A light emitter casting a beam along the instance's facing (north at yaw 0), half a metre up so it meets the mirror and lens stands. Turn the instance to aim it.

kind.description: What shines: a sunlight shaft, a crystal or a spell.

intensity.description: Strength of the beam; 1 is a sunbeam.
